{{Quote|This is the exploratory ship ''Pythea''.|Panha, to Dulac|<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion 0: Part 2" />}}
The '''''Pythea''''' was an [[Scout ship/Legends|exploratory ship]] owned by [[Panha]], a [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]], and [[Sarkkin]], a male [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]]. In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the [[Starship/Legends|ship]] intercepted a [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] crewed by the [[Yuuzhan Vong]]&mdash;a [[Species/Legends|species]] of [[The galaxy/Legends|extragalactic]] invaders&mdash;bound for the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Artorias]]. The crew of the ''Pythea'' attempted to contact Artorias, but they were at such a distance that the crew had to reroute all power to the transmission to send it successfully. Realizing the Yuuzhan Vong wanted to take them alive rather than [[Death/Legends|kill]] them, Panha and Sarkkin sacrificed themselves by [[Death/Legends|ramming]] the ship into a [[Miid ro'ik]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]] to prevent the Yuuzhan Vong from capturing them. The message to Artorias, however, was in vain, as the being who had received it, [[Dulac]], was in actuality a Yuuzhan Vong [[Spy/Legends|spy]].

==Description==
The ''Pythea'' was an [[Scout ship/Legends|exploratory ship]] that was [[Color/Legends|colored]] [[red]] and had several long [[Blaster cannon/Legends|blaster cannons]] on the front and back of the [[Cockpit/Legends|cockpit]]. The cockpit also housed the [[Pilot/Legends|piloting]] equipment. The [[Starship/Legends|ship]] was equipped with a [[Hyperdrive/Legends|hyperdrive]], a cargo hold, [[Deflector shield/Legends|deflector shields]], [[Sensor/Legends|scanners]], and communications equipment. The [[Aurebesh/Legends|Aurebesh]] letters "[[Usk/Legends|Usk]]" and "[[Dorn/Legends|Dorn]]" were emblazoned on the side of the ship.<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion 0: Part 1" />

==History==
{{Quote|«They're boarding us! Here they come!»''"<br />"''You're a Wookiee. Go tear their arms off.''"<br />"''«What if they don't have arms?»''"<br />"''Just tear things off until they can't fight anymore!|Panha and Sarkkin, as their ship is being boarded|<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion 0: Part 2" />}}
In [[25 ABY/Legends|25 ABY]], the ''Pythea'' was on an exploratory mission when the [[Gender/Legends|female]] [[Chiss/Legends|Chiss]] [[Panha]] and the male [[Wookiee/Legends|Wookiee]] [[Sarkkin]], the owners and operators of the vessel, received a transmission from [[Arbeloa]], the last surviving member of the [[Cilare (species)|Cilare]]. Arbeloa's message warned them about the [[The galaxy/Legends|extragalactic]] invaders known as the [[Yuuzhan Vong]], whose [[Fleet/Legends|fleet]] [[Battle of Vonak|had obliterated]] [[Vonak|his homeworld]]. At the same time, the ''Pythea''{{'s}} long-range scanners detected the incoming fleet. The crew attempted to send a transmission to [[Artorias]], the first inhabited [[Planet/Legends|planet]] in the fleet's trajectory, but they were too far away for it to be received. Deciding that it was more important to get closer and warn Artorias than it was to escape, the crew of the ''Pythea'' edged the ship toward the Yuuzhan Vong fleet and rerouted all power to the transmission. Noticing the vessel, the Yuuzhan Vong sent several ships commanded by [[Azca]] to intercept the ''Pythea''.<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion 0: Part 1" />
[[File:PytheaVSYoricVec.jpg|315px|left|thumbnail|The ''Pythea'' is shot by a Yorik-vec.]]
Before the ''Pythea'' could defend itself against the incoming vessels, [[Yorik-vec assault cruiser|Yorik-Vec]] ships began to fire on the exploratory ship. While the Yuuzhan Vong began to breach the ''Pythea''{{'s}} [[Hull/Legends|hull]], the transmission finally reached Artorias. Panha and Sarkkin informed [[Dulac]], the transmission's recipient and friend to [[Caled Galfridian|the planet's king]], of the fleet and sent to him all of the data that they had gathered on the armada as well. After Dulac received the information, the Yuuzhan Vong successfully penetrated the ''Pythea''{{'s}} hull and [[Warrior caste|warriors]] began to board the vessel. The boarding party was [[Death/Legends|killed]] by the crew, and&mdash;realizing that the Yuuzhan Vong wanted to take them alive rather than kill them&mdash;Panha and Sarkkin rammed the ''Pythea'' into a [[Miid ro'ik]] [[Cruiser/Legends|cruiser]]. The impact destroyed both the cruiser and the ''Pythea'', as well as several Yorik-Vecs nearby. The ''Pythea''{{'s}} sacrifice became one of the first strikes against the Yuuzhan Vong during their [[Yuuzhan Vong War|invasion]] of the galaxy. The warning to Artorias, however, was in vain, as Dulac, the being who received the message, was in reality a Yuuzhan Vong [[Spy/Legends|spy]].<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion 0: Part 2" /> Because of this, the Yuuzhan Vong [[Battle of Artorias|attack]] on Artorias took the planet's population by surprise, allowing the invaders to conquer the world.<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion: Refugees 2">[[Invasion 1|''Invasion'' 1]]</ref>

==Commanders and crew==
The ''Pythea'' was owned and operated by Panha and Sarkkin until their deaths and the ship's destruction.<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion 0: Part 1" />

==Behind the scenes==
The ''Pythea'' first appeared in [[Invasion 0|''Refugees, Prologue'']], an online preview of ''[[Star Wars: Invasion]]'', a [[Star Wars comic books|comic]] series published by [[Dark Horse Comics]]. The preview was released on [[May 8]], [[2009]], on the official ''[[Star Wars]]'' [[StarWars.com|website]].<ref name="Star Wars: Invasion Preview">{{SWArchive|url=invasion/index.html|text=''Star Wars Invasion'' Preview}}</ref>
